abilities.name: Slash
abilities.description: Strike a cardinally adjacent target. Damage equals effective STR.

warrior_blade.description: +2 STR. Grants Slash: damage equals effective STR; cardinally adjacent target.

abilities.name: Shield Bash
abilities.description: Charge a clear cardinal lane to a target within 3 squares, stop adjacent. Damage is effective CON divided by 3, rounded down, minimum 1.

warrior_shield.description: +2 CON. Grants Shield Bash: floor(CON / 3), minimum 1 damage; clear cardinal lane up to 3 squares, stop adjacent.
